style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, Kodak Portra 400 grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: Why I'm Writing This
images.concept: Careful investigation — the discipline of paying close attention before speaking
images.imageAlt: Close-up of rough handmade paper surface with diagonal shadow lines crossing it in warm raking light
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, overhead close-up of rough handmade paper surface, warm raking light from one edge revealing every fiber and grain of the material, a single shadow line crossing the surface — perhaps from a window frame or an object just outside the frame, no text, no writing implements, nothing readable — purely texture and the geometry of light on material, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain blending with the paper texture, muted warm cream and ash tones, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9 with light entering from left, shadow and texture filling the frame, the act of careful attention made visual

images.title: An Old Priest, an Empty Nursery
images.concept: A prayer repeated so long it has become the shape of a life — faithful duty and silent longing
images.imageAlt: A thin curl of smoke rising through a shaft of warm light in a dark stone interior
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a thin curl of smoke rising in an otherwise empty stone interior, the smoke backlit by a single shaft of afternoon light so it becomes luminous and visible against the dark background, the smoke moving and dissolving upward, nothing else in frame — no objects, no incense burner visible, just the smoke and the light and the dark stone, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain especially in shadow areas, muted warm gray palette with one column of warm amber light, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9 with smoke centered, dark surroundings, the unanswered prayer made visible

images.title: Mary Says Yes
images.concept: An ordinary moment interrupted — the threshold between one life and another
images.imageAlt: An open wooden door in a stone wall with morning light flooding through onto a rough stone floor
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a doorway or open window in a simple stone wall, morning light flooding through the opening onto a rough stone floor, the threshold itself sharp and clear while the room beyond dissolves into warm shadow, nothing and no one visible — just the opening and the light it admits, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, muted warm palette of stone and morning gold, the doorway as the entire subject, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9 with the opening slightly off-center, vast breathing space of lit floor in the foreground, the moment before everything changes

images.title: Two Women, Two Miracles
images.concept: The hill country path between two impossibilities — joy carried across distance
images.imageAlt: A narrow dirt path winding through dry golden hillside grass at golden hour, disappearing over a rise
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a narrow path through dry Judean hillside terrain at golden hour, the path winding through and disappearing over a rise, wild dry grass and low scrub on either side, warm low light turning the grass amber-gold, long shadows stretching across the path, no people, nothing at the end of the path visible — just the path continuing beyond the frame, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, deeply muted warm palette, Kinfolk landscape restraint, 16:9 with path leading from lower center toward upper third, vast sky above, sense of journey and arrival held in the landscape itself

images.title: Mary's Song
images.concept: The great reversal — power inverted, the overlooked given weight
images.imageAlt: A single wild grass stem glowing in side light, growing from a crack in a dark rough stone surface
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, stark close-up of a rough stone surface with a single wild grass stem growing from a crack, the grass lit from below or side so it glows against a deep shadow background, the stone massive and dark, the grass small and luminous, nothing else in frame, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, near-monochrome palette with the one note of warm light on the grass, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9 with the crack running diagonally and the grass catching the light in the lower third, the image holds the tension of smallness and strength

images.title: The Birth of John
images.concept: Speech returning after long silence — a name written, a voice given back
images.imageAlt: Close-up of pristine folded natural linen cloth with soft light casting gentle shadows in the folds
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, close-up of folded natural linen cloth, warm soft light falling evenly across the surface, the folds creating gentle shadow valleys in the weave, no damage, no tears, no stains — pristine undyed fabric in the most tender light, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain blending with the cloth texture, warm cream and ivory tones, deeply quiet and intimate, Alabaster Books tactile stillness, 16:9 with the fabric folds filling the frame, light coming from above, shadow only in the fold creases

images.title: Zechariah's Song
images.concept: Dawn breaking after a long silence — first light after the longest night
images.imageAlt: Pre-dawn landscape with dry grass silhouetted against a faint warm glow at the horizon under a dark sky
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, pre-dawn landscape, the horizon just beginning to separate sky from land, the faintest warm glow at the edge of the frame while most of the image remains in deep blue-gray darkness, dry grass or low scrub in silhouette against the brightening edge, no sun visible yet — just the first evidence of its coming, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain especially in the dark zones, muted cool blue palette with one thin warm note at the horizon, Kinfolk landscape stillness, 16:9 with horizon in lower third and vast dark sky above, the first light as the entire subject

images.title: Into the Wilderness
images.concept: Solitude that forms — the desert as the place where something essential is being made
images.imageAlt: Wide view of cracked dry desert terrain at late afternoon with a faint worn path disappearing into the distance
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, wide view of bare Judean desert terrain at late afternoon, the ground cracked dry earth and pale rock, a single worn path barely visible crossing the frame and disappearing, vast empty sky taking the upper half of the image, warm low light turning the earth amber-sienna, deep shadows in the cracks of the ground, no people, no destination visible, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, muted warm desert palette, Alabaster Books austere stillness, 16:9 with path in middle third, the emptiness itself the subject — preparation visible in absence
